reflection.text:
High-dose wells at 1 uM and 10 uM misled the run: extreme nuc_solidity and nuc_form_factor loss with cell loss (130-314 cells) produced an 8/10 protein-synthesis match in e4 that I initially weighted at 0.50, when this likely reflected secondary cytotoxicity and collapsed morphology rather than MoA.
Low-dose acquisition rescued the call: 0.03 uM and 0.1 uM wells preserved lobed polyploid large nuclei with dim diffuse tubulin, and the repeat atlas comparison in e10 shifted to 5/10 microtubule destabilizers with 0.95-0.98 match to demecolcine/nocodazole, outweighing the high-dose signal.
The lesson is to discount high-dose atlas resemblance when cell count drops and nuclear shape z-scores saturate near -30 to -47, and to prioritize low-dose shape plus tubulin texture and direct destabilizer references for vinca-like agents.
what_was_right: Acquired low-dose wells w_3415990e66 (0.03 uM) and w_f8df549b85 (0.1 uM) showing nuc_solidity z=-33.4 to -47.4 with frac_large_nucleus z=+16.7 to +21.6, revealing polyploidy without full toxicity.
Used second compare_to_reference_atlas on low-dose profile (e10) to overturn e4, correctly favoring demecolcine/nocodazole-like destabilizers over protein synthesis.
Used microscopist description of lobed polyploid nuclei with dim diffuse tubulin to favor microtubule destabilizers over stabilizers and Aurora inhibitors in final update to 0.68.
what_was_wrong: Over-weighted e4 high-dose 8/10 protein-synthesis match despite e2/e3 showing massive shape distortion and low cell counts, inflating protein synthesis to 0.50 and dropping destabilizers to 0.05.

Entertained microtubule stabilizers (0.12) and Aurora inhibitors (0.25) from e5 visual candidates and tub_std z=+21.4 at 10 uM, when increased tubulin variance reflected depolymerized diffuse signal not stabilized bundles.

Dose-response tests for frac_large_nucleus and cell_count (both rho=-0.80, p=0.2, e11-e12) were underpowered with 4 wells and did not discriminate, and one describe_phenotype call failed on non-acquired field f_16a688a49a97.

## Conclusion

**Microtubule destabilizers** (stated probability 0.68); key evidence e10, e8, e9, e7.

## PI review

Verdict: approve.

Clean profile; rep-1 voxels give a huge nuclear-region load, and broad uptake alone favors a chromatin-accessible agent over exclusion by efflux.

## Unblinding

Compound: **vincristine** (PubChem CID [5978](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/5978))

Identity check: name and BBBC021 structure agree

ChEMBL mechanisms: Tubulin inhibitor

## Verdict (computed by code)

Correct: agent said **Microtubule destabilizers**, BBBC021 annotates **Microtubule destabilizers**.

## Reflection

High-dose wells at 1 uM and 10 uM misled the run: extreme nuc_solidity and nuc_form_factor loss with cell loss (130-314 cells) produced an 8/10 protein-synthesis match in e4 that I initially weighted at 0.50, when this likely reflected secondary cytotoxicity and collapsed morphology rather than MoA.
Low-dose acquisition rescued the call: 0.03 uM and 0.1 uM wells preserved lobed polyploid large nuclei with dim diffuse tubulin, and the repeat atlas comparison in e10 shifted to 5/10 microtubule destabilizers with 0.95-0.98 match to demecolcine/nocodazole, outweighing the high-dose signal.
The lesson is to discount high-dose atlas resemblance when cell count drops and nuclear shape z-scores saturate near -30 to -47, and to prioritize low-dose shape plus tubulin texture and direct destabilizer references for vinca-like agents.

What was right:
- Acquired low-dose wells w_3415990e66 (0.03 uM) and w_f8df549b85 (0.1 uM) showing nuc_solidity z=-33.4 to -47.4 with frac_large_nucleus z=+16.7 to +21.6, revealing polyploidy without full toxicity.
- Used second compare_to_reference_atlas on low-dose profile (e10) to overturn e4, correctly favoring demecolcine/nocodazole-like destabilizers over protein synthesis.
- Used microscopist description of lobed polyploid nuclei with dim diffuse tubulin to favor microtubule destabilizers over stabilizers and Aurora inhibitors in final update to 0.68.

What was wrong or missed:
- Over-weighted e4 high-dose 8/10 protein-synthesis match despite e2/e3 showing massive shape distortion and low cell counts, inflating protein synthesis to 0.50 and dropping destabilizers to 0.05.
- Entertained microtubule stabilizers (0.12) and Aurora inhibitors (0.25) from e5 visual candidates and tub_std z=+21.4 at 10 uM, when increased tubulin variance reflected depolymerized diffuse signal not stabilized bundles.
- Dose-response tests for frac_large_nucleus and cell_count (both rho=-0.80, p=0.2, e11-e12) were underpowered with 4 wells and did not discriminate, and one describe_phenotype call failed on non-acquired field f_16a688a49a97.

Proposed next experiment: Cell-free tubulin polymerization assay with vincristine vs nocodazole/demecolcine controls, plus phospho-H3 and alpha-tubulin/DAPI immunofluorescence to quantify depolymerized spindles, multinucleation and washout recovery.
